pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE CALL OF DISCIPLES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: The Call of Disciples

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Call of Disciples. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
2. state how different people are called to serve God today

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
   In simple words: practise until you can retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. state how different people are called to serve God today
   In simple words: practise until you can state how different people are called to serve God today. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Call of Disciples using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Call of Disciples in the examples.
2. Explain The Call of Disciples to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Call of Disciples.
4. Show that you can: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Call of Disciples using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Call of Disciples important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss, in small groups, different roles they play in church and share in class
2. In turns, read Mark 1:16- 20 and retell the call of the first disciples,
3. Role-play the call of the first disciples,
4. Compose and sing a song on the call of the first four disciples,
5. Digital literacy: the skill of digital citizenship is enhanced as learners watch a video clip on the call of the first disciples.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
2. state how different people are called to serve God today

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
